options.text: I don't know. What can you do for me?

steps.player: I don't know. What can you do for me?

steps.npc: A good question indeed! I'm selling special clothing for Agility enthusiasts.
Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
Once you've got enough Marks, I'll exchange them for my Graceful clothing. So, does that interest you?

steps.text: If the player's lap counter is on

steps.npc: Sure, I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.

steps.text: If the player's lap counter is off

steps.npc: Sure, I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a rooftop course. To help you keep track.
